DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework has a Machine Learning R&D critical capability level. Through
Gemini 3.1 Pro it was evaluated on five of METR's seven RE-Bench tasks, reported as a human-normalized
average within a 32-hour budget; the Gemini 3.7 Flash FSF report switches to an internal research
engineering benchmark (GRB, 74 tasks, 2-hour timeout) with a 90 percent pass@1 rule-out threshold.
Flash cards defer the determination to the most capable Pro model of the time.
